manifest.description: Small habits, every day: reminders, streaks and a daily report.

update.description: A new version of Restart is ready.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: Restart can't reach the internet right now. Check your connection and try again.
offline.hint: Pages you opened recently still work without a connection.

install.description: Add Restart to your Home Screen to open it in one tap and get reminders.
install.compact: Install Restart for one-tap access and reminders.
install.installed: Restart is installed on this device.
install.installedHint: Open it from your Home Screen or app list.
install.justInstalled: Done! Restart is now on this device.

ios.step1: Tap Share in Safari's toolbar. On iOS 26, tap ••• first.
ios.step2: Choose Add to Home Screen. You may need to scroll down.
ios.step3: Tap Add, then open Restart from your Home Screen.
ios.notifications: Notifications on iPhone need iOS 16.4 or later, and Restart opened from the Home Screen.
ios.oldIos: This iPhone can't get notifications from web apps yet. Update to iOS 16.4 or later to get reminders.
ios.otherBrowser: Don't see Add to Home Screen? Open this page in Safari.

android.step2: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
android.step3: Confirm, then open Restart from your Home Screen.

desktop.chromium: Chrome or Edge: click the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose Install Restart.
desktop.other: Other browsers may not install web apps. Restart works in any browser tab too.
